438:t_002:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「Watch out! Something else is coming!」

438:t_002:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Are those $$インベーダー#robot$$ reinforcements?!」

438:t_003:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It looks like they're all $$太陽系限定種$$.」

438:t_003:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It doesn't matter. If they're $$宇宙怪獣$$, I'll crush them.」

438:t_003:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, I request a tactical decision.」

438:t_003:5.en:
$$レド$$
「...Maybe there's really no reason to fight those $$宇宙怪獣$$ either.」

438:t_003:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I cannot comprehend the intent of that statement. I request your orders again.」

438:t_003:7.en:
$$レド$$
「...No, never mind. We'll intercept them.」

438:t_003:9.en:
$$レド$$
(The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ were actually humans who artificially evolved themselves...)

438:t_003:10.en:
$$レド$$
(Will the day come when I tell everyone that truth...?)

438:t_003:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There aren't many $$宇宙怪獣$$. All units, intercept them.」

438:t_003:13.en:
$$宗介$$
($$テッサ$$ is trying to shake off despair and fight. Then I must too...!)

438:t_004:0.en:
$$恵子$$
「We have radar contacts! Something's coming!」

438:t_005:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Now it's that mysterious robot army!」

438:t_005:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「They aren't part of $$ズール$$'s forces, right?」

438:t_005:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's right. Their identity is still unknown.」

438:t_005:3.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Either way, they're enemies, so we just have to beat them!」

438:t_005:4.en:
$$ダリー$$
「But at this rate, it'll turn into a free-for-all...!」

438:t_005:5.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Then we'll just shoot them all down, one after another!」

438:t_005:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「Our Princess can't let her show us up either.」

438:t_005:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You don't have to tell me...! I don't intend to get killed before reaching $$蒼の地球$$!」

438:t_005:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go, everyone! These bastards can't even say hello. There's no need to hold back!!」

438:t_006:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「It looks like the main attraction's here!」

438:t_007:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You really are a slow learner, kid. I'm $$アムブリエル$$ now.」

438:t_007:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Coming to finish us off in the confusion? That's a dirty trick, hardly befitting a lady.」

438:t_007:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You expect too much of women. Or are you projecting your ideals onto $$西条涼音$$ too?」

438:t_007:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Men do love female teachers and nurses, after all.」

438:t_007:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I won't deny it! But I didn't want to hear it from Miss $$スズネ$$!」

438:t_007:6.en:
$$桂$$
「$$ＡＧ$$ told us you're Miss $$スズネ$$'s other personality.」

438:t_007:7.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...So $$ＡＧ$$ sided with you. Well, that was only to be expected.」

438:t_007:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of talking to you. We'll fight you in $n's place.」

438:t_007:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Oh... So he's not here... Heh... What a shame.」

438:t_007:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Judging by your tone... you know about $n's condition.」

438:t_007:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Did you choose $n's absence to make your move and seize $$ジェニオン$$?」

438:t_007:12.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm not the only one who's been waiting for an opening.」

438:t_008:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「Those are $$ズール$$ and $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s armies!」

438:t_008:1.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Against you as you are now, this should be more than enough.」

438:t_008:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「You're saying even your avatar won't lose?!」

438:t_008:4.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Exactly. The power of darkness is growing as the great collapse, which comes once every 120 million years, approaches.」

438:t_008:5.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「If you think $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ and I are the same as before, I'll show you how wrong you are.」

438:t_008:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「So $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ has grown stronger too...!」

438:t_008:7.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Now that the whole cast is here, shall we begin? This should be a delightful party.」

438:t_009:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「No...! You sent him out when he hasn't even regained consciousness...!」

438:t_009:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「What are you doing, $$クロウ$$?! Are you trying to get $n killed?!」

438:t_009:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I asked $$クロウ$$ to do it. I asked him to deploy $n if Miss $$スズネ$$ appeared.」

438:t_009:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Cut the crap, $$ＡＧ$$! $n can't possibly fight in this state!」

438:t_009:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n entrusted all emergency measures to me. $n has already agreed to this.」

438:t_009:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「Measures...?! What do you think a human being is?!」

438:t_009:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Carbon compounds with a soul inside. Nothing more.」

438:t_009:13.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Exactly, $$ＡＧ$$. ...But what those carbon compounds produce is precisely what you're after, isn't it?」

438:t_009:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have no intention of talking to you. It's Miss $$スズネ$$ I want to see.」

438:t_009:15.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're so cold. Then I'll do as I please!」

438:t_010:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「You idiot, $$クロウ$$! You let $$ＡＧ$$ talk you into this, knowing this would happen?!」

438:t_010:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What are you talking about?! Did $$ＡＧ$$ buy you off?!」

438:t_010:8.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I understand your resolve! But we can't let $n get killed!」

438:t_010:10.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「What do we do?! We can't even retreat like this!」
